notes: Governmental funds modified cash basis (General, Street, Other (Keno Fund)); business-type funds (Electric, Water, Solid Waste, Sewer) accrual basis. Governmental lines from the governmental funds Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances (p5, Total Governmental Funds column); roll-forward 364,181 + 371,930 - 307,340 + transfers in 53,000 (General 3,000 + Street 50,000) - transfers out 3,000 (Keno) = 478,771 (Total column prints net 50,000; recorded gross from fund columns as FY2023). 'Licenses, rents, and fees' 14,058 split by the General Fund departments Total column (Licenses and permits 4,031 + Rental and fees 10,027, p13). Beginning cash not printed (null). Ending cash = cash and cash equivalents + county treasurer cash; ending investments = certificates of deposit + investments (governmental funds Balance Sheet p4). Business-type lines from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position (p7, Total column); roll-forward 1,590,486 + 1,189,940 - 969,184 - 38,286 = 1,772,956. The Statement of Activities shows governmental transfers 38,286 vs the fund statement net 50,000 (modified cash vs accrual reconciliation; no roll-forward gap). Statement of Cash Flows (pp8-9 Total column) in proprietary. Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), because the governmental funds Balance Sheet (total 478,771) excludes governmental capital assets. Detail: General Fund from the combining departments schedule (pp12-13, one line per department column; supersedes the General Fund budgetary comparison schedule p10, not recorded to avoid double counting); Street Fund from its budgetary comparison schedule (p11). Keno Fund and the utility funds have no schedule of their own (no all-funds budget schedule in the FY2022 trim), so no detail lines for them. Airport department expenditures (452) are under Public works on the fund statement, Main Street Building under Environment and leisure. Component unit (El Dorado Manor) excluded. Read pages 1-13 of 13
